title: Bayou Neon Sorceress
description: A woman with elaborate magenta hair adorned with flowers stands on a wooden bayou porch at sunset. She wears ornate green and gold armor, holds a glowing purple energy sword, and is surrounded by floating fast food items, magical green tentacles, a purple swirling portal, and a large mystical tree containing a horse head, white bird, and a smiling cloud face.
prompt: A woman with vibrant magenta curly hair and flowers stands on a weathered wooden porch over a Louisiana bayou at sunset. She wears intricate green and gold armor with a white ruff collar and holds a glowing purple energy sword. Floating around her are hamburgers, french fries, and beads. From a large ancient tree with Spanish moss emerge green tentacles, a purple swirling portal, a white horse head, a pelican, and a smiling cloud. Purple hammock, magical atmosphere, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
